title: Same amount, different name
_map: Same amount, different name (Y2). Big idea: 2/4 = 1/2 (equivalent fractions). Creative: find other fractions that are the same as one half.
_story: Two fields side by side. Steve gets half of one; Ismaeel gets two quarters of the other. Steve thinks it got less because 1 is smaller than 2. They compare.
_stepChain: halves and quarters (sharing-pies) → half a field next to two quarters of the same field → same amount → different names for the same amount are called equivalent → hunt: 3/6, 4/8 → Steve's mistake

talk.ask: Is 2/4 the same as 1/2? How do you know?
talk.goodAnswer: yes: put them side by side and the shaded parts cover the same amount.

talk.ask: Can you think of another fraction that's the same as one half?

handsOn: Fold a paper strip in half and colour one half. Fold another strip into quarters and colour two. Lay them side by side. Same?

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: We each got part of a field. I got half of this one. You got 2 quarters of that one. I got 1 part and you got 2 parts. That's not fair!

question.prompt: Who has more of the field?
question.onRight: Yes. You compared the shaded parts, not the number of pieces.

0.mistake: thinks bigger pieces means more in total
0.hint: Look at how much green there is in each field, not how many pieces.
0.say: Steve's piece is bigger, but you have two pieces. Together your 2 quarters cover exactly the same as one half.

2.mistake: thinks more pieces means more in total
2.hint: You have 2 pieces, but they're smaller. Compare how much green there is.
2.say: You have 2 pieces, but each is a quarter, half the size of a half. 2 quarters cover exactly the same as 1 half.

narration.text: Different names for the same amount are called equivalent fractions. One half is equivalent to two quarters.
Let's hunt for more. Cut a field into 8 equal strips and shade 4. Still half! Shade half of the parts, and it's always one half.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I found one! 3 out of 4 is the same as a half!

question.onRight: Yes, you caught it. 3 of 4 is more than half. Half of 4 parts is 2 parts.

0.mistake: doesn't check that exactly half the parts are shaded
0.hint: Half of 4 parts is how many parts?
0.say: Half of 4 parts is 2 parts. 3 parts is more than half: it's three quarters.

question.reveal: 3/4 is more than 1/2. 2/4 is the half.

rule.ask: Can you say what equivalent fractions are? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Equivalent fractions are different names for the same amount. One half equals two quarters equals four eighths.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: which is the same as one half: 5/10, 5/8 or 2/5?
